audit.whatIsWrong: Two rows contradict this page's own prose. Level 1 is marked Skill while whys[0] and early both say levels 1-2 are 'firmly yours'; 2+ items is marked Skill while whys[6], late and spikes[3] all say a fully-built Irelia out-DPSes you.
audit.why: The packet chart and the mirror both give Level 1 to Volibear, and the packet gives 2+ items to Irelia, which is what the page's own late-game text describes. 56.05% over 1472 games is a Volibear-favoured lane that decays with her scaling.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0].side -> Volibear at 6/10; win[6]/phases[6].side -> Irelia at 3/10.

audit.why: Her spikes are passive stacks, Flawless Duet online, and the first-item timing where Bladesurge resets start chaining; yours are levels 3-5 and the level-6 Stormbringer window at 160s. The page already lands these.
audit.corrected: Kept, with Bladesurge's reset condition now written down.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED NAME: spikes[2] calls her E 'Blade of the Exile (E, stun)'. Blade of the Exile is Riven's ultimate. Irelia's E is Flawless Duet.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon slot E: 'Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.' 850 range, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says that only the space between the two blades stuns, and nothing connects the Mark to her reset.
audit.why: Riot's text: enemies 'caught in between' are stunned and Marked, and Bladesurge's 'cooldown refreshes' if the target is Marked or dies to it. That chain — E marks you, Q resets onto you — is the whole reason her all-in works.
audit.corrected: Stand outside the convergence line; and remember the stun Marks you, which refreshes her 10s Bladesurge.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] recommends Executioner's Calling and says it cuts 'his' healing.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every strike and it is her reset, so anti-heal is correct here — the sentence just names the wrong person.

edits.before: This is where it evens out: once Irelia finishes her first item and has passive stacks up, her Q resets and Blade of the Exile (E, stun) let her trade back through your W.
edits.after: This is where it evens out: once Irelia finishes her first item and has passive stacks, her Bladesurge (Q) resets and Flawless Duet (E) stun trade back through your W.

edits.before: You crush early Irelia: Thundering Smash (Q) runs her down before she has stacks, Frenzied Maul (W) out-heals her Bladesurge (Q) poke, and Sky Splitter (E) punishes her whenever her dash is on a minion cooldown.
edits.after: You crush early Irelia: Thundering Smash (Q) runs her down before she has stacks, Frenzied Maul (W) heals every 5s through her Bladesurge (Q) poke, and Sky Splitter (E) punishes her when there is no marked target to reset onto.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Irelia Flawless Duet: Sends two blades that converge to stun — her engage CC. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Flawless Duet (E): matchup-defining — 850 range, 16s at rank 1; two blades converge and only the space between them stuns. - Bladesurge (Q): 10s, but it refreshes on a Marked target or a kill.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Two blades converge — only the gap between them stuns. It is 16s.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Flawless Duet also Marks you, and a Marked target refreshes her Bladesurge.

edits.before: Track Irelia's Flawless Duet (Stun): Her engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in her.
edits.after: Flawless Duet (E) is 850 range on 16s and only stuns between the blades. Bladesurge refreshes on Marked.
